hero.title: Biomedical Engineering (UG) in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: Biomedical engineering is the fusion of engineering, biology, medicine and technology to create health care related equipment and systems. If you are a student interested in medical devices, artificial organs, rehabilitation technology, diagnostic equipment and healthcare innovation, this could be the field for you. **Biomedical Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students** is a study option worth researching for students interested in combining engineering principles with healthcare technology.

overview: Important to prospective students: The University of Mauritius has not listed a specific Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering in its published undergraduate program list for the 2026–2027 academic year. It also has related programs such as Pharmaceutical Biotechnology, Applied Biochemistry, Mechatronics Engineering and Electrical and Electronic Engineering. They are alternative study paths, not equal qualifications in Biomedical Engineering. Students planning to **Study Biomedical Engineering in Mauritius** should understand the difference between a dedicated biomedical engineering degree and related science or engineering qualifications.

faq.question: Can I study a Bachelor’s in Biomedical Engineering in Mauritius?
faq.answer: A dedicated Bachelor’s in Biomedical Engineering was not found in the University of Mauritius’s published undergraduate programme list for 2026–2027. Students can investigate related programmes such as Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Pharmaceutical Biotechnology and Applied Biochemistry. Students researching Biomedical Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students should verify the current programme list before applying.

faq.question: Which university should I contact for related courses?
faq.answer: The University of Mauritius is a useful starting point because it publishes undergraduate programmes in engineering and science. Contact the university directly to confirm course availability, admission requirements and whether any relevant specialisation is offered. Students comparing Biomedical Engineering Universities in Mauritius should also verify the accreditation of the specific programme.

faq.question: What is the cost of studying Biomedical Engineering in Mauritius?
faq.answer: A verified tuition fee for a dedicated Biomedical Engineering degree is not available because the programme itself has not been confirmed. As an initial budget, estimated living expenses are around MUR 20,500–39,000 per month, or approximately ₹38,950–₹74,100, using the illustrative exchange rate in this article. Tuition and other charges are additional. For accurate Biomedical Engineering Fees in Mauritius, students should contact the institution directly.

faq.question: What subjects should I study before applying?
faq.answer: Mathematics and science subjects are useful preparation for many engineering and biotechnology programmes. The exact subjects and grades required depend on the course, so check the selected university’s admission criteria. Students should also review Biomedical Engineering Eligibility in Mauritius before choosing their undergraduate programme.

faq.question: Can I pursue a Master’s in Biomedical Engineering after studying in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Potentially, yes. Students completing a relevant undergraduate degree may qualify for certain postgraduate programmes, depending on prerequisites. However, admission is not automatic: universities may require specific engineering, mathematics, biology or physics credits.
